runs.name: Galaxy Entertainment Group Limited; HKEX 0027 and a US OTC ADR, five shares per ADS; a Macau casino-resort concessionaire through Galaxy Casino, S.A., with Galaxy Macau, Broadway Macau and StarWorld, Cotai Phase 4 under way, a construction materials division and a Wynn Resorts stake; not an SEC registrant; Las Vegas Sands, Wynn and Melco read as a CONVENTION of the run, MGM China not read, SJM flagged
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **HK$33.06** a share (HKEX close 2026-10-14; Yahoo chart API, aggregator, flagged), **HK$165.30 per ADS**; the ADR GXYYY **US$20.80** (US OTC close 2026-10-13, aggregator, flagged); five shares per ADS from the depositary's F-6EF of 2022-04-05, accession 0001193805-22-000585 (CIK 1679056). Shares **4,379,240,712**, one class (2026 Interim Report note 18 at 2026-06-30; the same at 2025-12-31 in the 2025 Annual Report note 27; the HKEX Monthly Return for September 2026, announced 2026-10-07, no change, no treasury shares); cap **HK$144,778M**. Sovereign **4.597%**, the 20-year HKSAR Institutional Government Bond closing reference yield 2026-10-13, from the HKSAR Government Bond Programme's own file (hkgb.gov.hk, administered by the HKMA), the 20-year taken because the issuer publishes no 30-year yield, a CONVENTION of the run; the HKMA API returned blank fields and then refused requests. Earnings currency the Hong Kong dollar as the filer reports, pataca and renminbi exposure noted, not converted. Filings read, from the company (dates in place of accessions, the brief's departure): the 2025 Annual Report (posted 2026-04-09), the 2026 Interim Report (posted 2026-09-16), the Annual Reports 2015 to 2024, the September 2026 monthly return and the interim dividend declaration; one figure cross-checked (2025 revenue HK$49,242,325 thousand in the income statement against the MD&A and the five-year summary). `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` returned not an SEC filer; every figure by hand. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report's business sections, Chairman's Statement, MD&A, principal-risks pointer and segment note (the brief's departure), stated in the run file. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: gaming and entertainment decides at 90% of 2021 to 2025 adjusted EBITDA (the filer's measure, used to size the parts only); the concession runs 2023-01-01 to 2032-12-31, inside the ten years, with the casino areas reverted to the Macau Government "without compensation" on 2022-12-30 and handed back for the term only, the impairment test and the depreciation lives resting on the filer's belief that it will win the next tender; Macau GGR set twice in ten years by policy, down 34% in 2015 under the anti-corruption programme and from HK$283.9bn in 2019 to HK$41.0bn in 2022 under closures, Galaxy losing money before tax in 2020 and 2022; the 2022 law added a MOP33.75bn investment commitment and wound down the satellite casinos; the Macau complementary-tax exemption runs only to 2027. Contrary evidence weighed at Q1 and recorded: the television-licence rows **[M2004-058]**, the macro foundation **[L1994-004]**, all six incumbents renewed in 2022, record visitation of 40.1M in 2025. Facts after the stop, not weighed: the reports name no rival; Macau EBITDA margins 25% to 36% at LVS, Wynn and Melco against Galaxy Macau's 31% to 33%; Macau EBITDA 2019 to 2025 LVS -28%, Wynn -21%, Melco -13%, Galaxy's gaming segment -11% as reported, about -21% luck-adjusted; Galaxy's share of Macau GGR 22.9% in 2018, 17.8% in 2023, 20.4% in 2025; fixed assets HK$37.7bn to HK$54.8bn 2020 to 2025 while segment earnings fell from HK$15.5bn to HK$13.8bn; the Wynn stake cost HK$7,142M and is worth HK$4,869M; Q12 names casinos **[M2007-018]**, a weighing for a stake bought in the market. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: the featured adjusted EBITDA excludes stock pay. Owner cash (HK$M, before interest, depreciation standing in for maintenance as a disclosed guess, Macau tax at the statutory rate): 2015 to 2019 average 9,150 (the cycle base); 2020 to 2022 (10,294), (5,880), (4,885); 2023 to 2025 7,262, 6,102, 8,317; growth from the 2015 to 2019 cycle to the three years since reopening -3.85% a year, carried as the bottom; the literal 2021 to 2025 window 2,019, shown. Balance sheets 2015 to 2025: equity HK$73.6bn (2019) to 63.9bn (2022) to 83.1bn (2025); cash and securities about HK$46bn, 25bn, 37bn in those years; borrowings never above about HK$9.9bn; creditors HK$20bn to 8bn explain the negative operating cash flow of 2021 to 2022; net cash HK$33.5bn at 2026-06-30 after the HK$0.90 interim dividend. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: value range **HK$41.75 to 54.08** a share (HK$208.75 to 270.40 per ADS) at the 4.597% HKSAR 20-year; fair **HK$26.86** a share all-equity (HK$134.31 per ADS), **HK$20.89** equity-only (HK$104.43 per ADS), not armed, the box being TOO HARD at Q1; no case earns the floor at the price (best about 8.2%, 9.5% in the most generous variant). Contamination declared by the analyst: the five most recent commit subjects (another company's run and fold) and the memory-index lines, none about this company, none used. **Declared by the analyst and recorded here:** a helper subagent extracted the rivals' segment figures from the cached SEC filings under the same blind rule (the run-agent pattern of this project runs no helper agents; the canonical brief does not say so; for the operator). Write-early: commits at the template copy, at Q1 and at the close (cd3af4fb, f066d400, f4cd29eb); the 2015 to 2025 statements were extracted in one pass before Q1 was written, and the Q1 verdict was committed before any Q7 arithmetic. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `scripts/check_citations.py` clean; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_citecheck2.py` 43 ids, 19 quoted fragments beside an id, no missing id, no E-id, no slip. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) a licence that ends inside the horizon has no stated home, Q1 or Q2 (both TOO HARD (NATURE)); (2) no line between the macro foundation ignoring political forecasts and a policy that is the term of the business's own licence; (3) Q7's perpetuity credits a renewal a finite concession cannot show, the concession-only figure shown beside; (4) Whose tax names carryforwards and credits, not exemptions renewed by decree, about 15% of owner cash; (5) specific (a) has no rule for growth when the second cycle is incomplete; (6) the protocol's sovereign table has no rule for an issuer with no 30-year bond. Could not get: a maintenance figure, Melco's 2014 to 2016 figures, MGM China, the HKMA API series.
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): the Macau concession ends 2032-12-31, inside the ten years, with the casinos already reverted to the government without compensation, and policy cut Macau's gaming revenue twice in ten years (2015 by 34%, 2019 to 2022 from HK$283.9bn to HK$41.0bn); the tax exemption runs to 2027. After the stop, not weighed: margins like the rivals', Macau share near a fifth, growth spending not yet earning, a large net cash. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: value HK$41.75 to 54.08 at the 4.597% HKSAR 20-year against HK$33.06, no case earning the floor, fair HK$26.86 all-equity, HK$20.89 equity-only, not armed. A helper subagent used by the analyst, declared. Framework gaps for the operator: a licence ending inside the horizon; macro forecasts against licence terms; a perpetuity for a finite concession; decree tax exemptions; an incomplete second cycle; no 30-year rate.
